Configured capabilities

What Towbot can be engineered to deliver.

These capabilities are presented as configurable or application-dependent. Each case is assessed against the vessel, operating profile and approval route.

01

Autonomous-assisted operation

Towbot is designed for supervised remote operation and autonomous-assisted functions such as approach, positioning and control support. A designated human operator retains command authority at all times.

Supervised autonomy

02

24-hour availability concepts

Duty cycling, charging strategy, battery sizing and fleet rotation can be designed for continuous port service and 24-hour availability. This describes the service architecture — not infinite endurance from one charge.

Continuous service

03

Up to 50% operating cost reduction

Selected operating profiles may achieve operating-cost reductions of up to 50%. Each case is assessed against actual vessel movements, existing arrangements, energy requirements, crewing and infrastructure.

Cost efficiency

360° Directional thrust options
3 Power classes available
50% Potential savings in selected profiles
0 Towbot crew onboard

Common architecture

One platform principle. Three power classes.

The Towbot architecture is designed around a common set of mechanical, electrical and control principles that scale across the product range.

Propulsion

Azimuthing electric thruster

Full 360° directional thrust with fast push-pull switching. Propulsor type, diameter and configuration are application-specific. No towline required for the selected operation.

Energy

Onboard battery system

Battery chemistry, capacity and charging architecture are sized to the operating duty. Charging strategy and unit rotation are designed to support continuous availability where required.

Attachment

Temporary hull interface

Application-specific temporary attachment system. No permanent vessel conversion or structural modification required. Interface design is part of the application engineering scope.

Control

Supervised remote control

Operator commands thrust magnitude and direction from a designated control station. Autonomous-assisted functions available for approach, positioning and holding. Override and emergency stop always available.
